stories.title: The Elusive Choreographer Sarah Michelson Is Turning MoMA Into a Dance Palace
stories.source: The New York Times — Art & Design
stories.sum: Sarah Michelson presents her expansive vision of dance at the Museum of Modern Art, where she will take over the atrium in her exhibition, “nowhere.”

stories.title: AI models need more data about biology, and OpenAI is paying to create it
stories.sum: Last year, the clinical trial policy analyst Ruxandra Teslo posted an idea for super-charging medical AI systems: use data from failed biotech companies.

stories.title: Trump caves to tougher ethics crackdown as his crypto fortune faces scrutiny
stories.sum: President Donald Trump has agreed to a significant portion of a stringent ethics proposal that is part of broader cryptocurrency legislation

stories.title: Christie’s to Auction Antonio Homem Sonnabend’s $50 M. Art Collection
stories.sum: The lot features works from Jeff Koons, Jasper Johns, Robert Rauschenberg, Roy Lichtenstein, and Andy Warhol.

stories.title: Poole Old Lifeboat Museum temporarily closes due to anti-migrant protests

stories.title: Alex Bores Wants Democrats to Make AI Safety a 2028 Election Issue
stories.sum: Alex Bores, who lost a congressional primary contest that revolved around A.I. regulation, is trying to position himself at the center of the conversation for the next presidential election.

stories.title: EU cyber rules put crypto wallet makers on 24-hour reporting clock
stories.sum: Crypto wallet providers must submit an early vulnerability report within 24 hours and a full notification within 72 hours of exploits, or risk administrative fines of as much as $17.3 million.

stories.title: Macklemore supported by major artists following removal from Ed Sheeran tour for Palestine stance
stories.sum: Kneecap, CMAT, Paloma Faith, Garbage, Zara Larsson and Greta Thunberg have all offered their support to the rapper

stories.title: James McNeill Whistler’s Music for the Eyes
stories.sum: A long-awaited Whistler retrospective at Tate Britain makes the case that every brushstroke, color, and omission serves the pursuit of harmony.

stories.title: Knicks Legend Karl-Anthony Towns and Jordyn Woods Curate a Sotheby’s Auction
stories.sum: The couple has handpicked 10 artworks for the auction house's Contemporary Curated sale. The post Knicks Legend Karl-Anthony Towns and Jordyn Woods Curate a Sotheby’s Auction appeared first on Artnet News .

stories.title: AI 'kill switch' may need to be mandatory, Anthropic co-founder says
stories.sum: Jack Clark says "most labs have different ways of being able to pull the plug", but says this may need to be a requirement.

stories.title: How a Warhol Portrait Landed in the Middle of Carolina Herrera’s Spring/Summer 2027 Collection
stories.sum: Ahead of the house's 45th anniversary show, Creative Director Wes Gordon freed Carolina Herrera's portrait from its frame, inviting Warholian allure into the fold...

stories.title: New Museum Appoints Ten New Trustees
stories.sum: Following a major building expansion, the New Museum has added ten new members to its board of trustees, expanding its existing slate and bringing its total membership to nearly fifty.
